title: OpenAI just changed math forever. Exactly how, no one yet knows
title_zh: OpenAI 彻底改变了数学——究竟如何，尚无定论
abstract: After massive dump of AI-generated solutions to nearly 400 problems, mathematicians wonder: Has their field been decimated or invigorated?
abstract_zh: 在向近400道问题提交大量 AI 生成的解答后，数学家们开始思考：这一技术是摧毁了还是振兴了他们的学科？
snippet: After massive dump of AI-generated solutions to nearly 400 problems, mathematicians wonder: Has their field been decimated or invigorated?
